surprises: The two sides of the comparison normalize differently: generate-ch-schema.mjs collapses `\s*\n\s*` to a single space, so a DDL-formatted multi-line literal keeps spaces inside the parentheses that system.columns never emits, and normalizeType's whitespace-run collapse cannot reconcile them.

That defect is invisible today only because all 17 snapshot tables use scalar Nullable/LowCardinality types — the gate would report false-positive breaking drift the first time a Tuple, Map, Nested, or AggregateFunction column enters the snapshot.

The phase's lint gate passed while the new entry script was never linted at all: apps/api/eslint.config.mjs ignores scripts/ wholesale, so a green lint gate said nothing about the file the phase's smoke command actually runs.

proposed_rules.diff: +- **Compare a generated snapshot to a live source through one shared normalizer, and unit-test the hardest literal the source can emit.** Two normalizers written against the same intent still disagree: the generator collapsing `\s*\n\s*` to a space and the reader collapsing whitespace runs produce different strings for the same multi-line `Tuple(...)`, and the diff reports drift that does not exist. Test the nested and multi-line forms, not only the scalar shapes the snapshot happens to hold today — a comparator validated solely on the easy case is validated on the case that was never going to fail.

+- **A script under `apps/*/scripts/` catches its own I/O failures and exits with a one-line cause.** Top-level `await` on an unreachable host, a wrong password, or a missing grant rejects into an unhandled-rejection stack. The exit code is still non-zero, so the gate fails closed and the bug hides — but the operator reads a crash instead of a connection problem, and these scripts are unlinted (`scripts/` is ignored by the ESLint flat config), so nothing else will catch it.

followups: All six followups were addressed on the branch immediately after the phase commit, before push: normalizeType strips whitespace adjacent to punctuation (with a collapsed multi-line Tuple test); the drift script catches query failures and reports a one-line cause; the copied argv comment is gone; schema-drift.ts is excluded from tsconfig.build.json so production dist/ omits it; describeFinding's missing_table and missing_column branches are asserted through formatDrift; and apps/api/scripts/ gets untyped ESLint coverage (both entry scripts brought to green, including a super-linear regex in generate-ch-schema.mjs).
